description: This file defines a JavaScript/TypeScript class 'JavaScriptLanguageGenerator' that generates code snippets for browser automation using Playwright, including methods for generating actions, headers, footers, and formatting code. It is part of a code generation tool for Playwright test scripts.

classes.name: JavaScriptLanguageGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates JavaScript code snippets for browser automation with Playwright, supporting test and standalone modes.

classes.name: JavaScriptFormatter
classes.description: A helper class for formatting JavaScript code with proper indentation and line management.

methods.name: generateAction
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for a specific browser automation action based on the action context.

methods.name: _generateActionCall
methods.description: Creates the code string for executing a specific action on a page or element.

methods.name: generateHeader
methods.description: Generates the header part of the code, depending on whether it's a test or standalone script.

methods.name: generateFooter
methods.description: Generates the footer part of the code, including closing context and browser.

methods.name: generateTestHeader
methods.description: Creates the header for a Playwright test, including imports and test setup.

methods.name: generateTestFooter
methods.description: Creates the footer for a Playwright test.

methods.name: generateStandaloneHeader
methods.description: Creates the header for a standalone Playwright script.

methods.name: generateStandaloneFooter
methods.description: Creates the footer for a standalone Playwright script.

methods.name: formatOptions
methods.description: Formats options objects into code string representations.

methods.name: formatContextOptions
methods.description: Formats browser context options, including device descriptors, into code.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Escapes and quotes a string for inclusion in code.

methods.name: wrapWithStep
methods.description: Wraps code in a Playwright test.step() call if a description is provided.

methods.name: quoteMultiline
methods.description: Quotes a multiline string for code inclusion, with proper escaping.

methods.name: isMultilineString
methods.description: Checks if a string is a multiline string.
